note: The keeper's camp (docs/future/13). The pad's shape, level and lock fade live in the land recipe's camp block; this holds what the camp says and how its tent, fire ring, lantern, light, smoke and moths look and behave (E3). The pad is locked ground (CP-01): no brush, erosion or boulder moves it, and a loose stone, a spring or a pour of water tapped on it is refused with one quiet line on the island.

giftStone.name: Gift stone
giftStone.empty: A flat stone with shells set on it. What the creatures give is left here.
giftStone.toSpot: Taken up. It is on your gift spot now.
giftStone.knownRose: The creatures near camp are getting used to it. They let you a little closer than they used to.

keepsakeShelf.name: Keepsake shelf
keepsakeShelf.line: Driftwood boards lashed with cord. The things you kept from the shore stand here, each in its own space.
keepsakeShelf.empty: Driftwood boards with sixteen spaces. What you keep from the shore will stand here.
keepsakeShelf.tinLine: A flat tin on top of the shelf. The letters from bottles you have read are kept in it.
keepsakeShelf.tinNone: A flat tin on top of the shelf, empty for now. A letter from a bottle, once read, is kept in it.

tentSlot.name: Tent ground
tentSlot.line: A level patch for your tent, out of the wind.

tent.name: Your tent
tent.line: Canvas on two poles, your bedroll rolled inside.

ringSlot.name: Ring ground
ringSlot.line: Bare earth in the middle of the camp, for a fire ring.

ring.name: Fire ring
ring.laid: Stones in a ring, the wood laid inside, cold.
ring.lowFlames: Burning low now. A handful would lift it.
ring.low: The rain keeps it low and hissing.
ring.embers: Banked embers under the ash. A little more wood would wake them.
ring.cold: A cold ring of stones and ash.

words.ringNeeds: The ring needs a handful of fuel and two handfuls of stones.
words.feedNeeds: A handful of twigs or sticks would feed it.

wordsNote: clear: the quiet line when a loose stone, a spring or a pour lands on the camp pad. Shown for walker.json words.noticeS seconds, once per press. The Plant tool says it too when a seed is tapped on the pad (CP-16). The rest: the tent and ring cards (names and lines by state), the card actions and here-bar buttons, and the quiet lines when something is missing.
grassNote: thinWithWear: how much the pad's wear (the land recipe's camp.wear) thins the grass blades toward the pad's center (0 none, 1 all of the wear). The blades' height cap is camp.grassScale, softened over camp.edgeWearM outside the pad.
glowNote: CS-05: a slot glows (a soft filled ring on the ground) the first time, then only while the pack holds what it needs and you are on or within nearM of the pad. opacity and breathS: its look. firstGlowWithinM: an older island's tent ground glows the first time you go down this near.
reachNote: How near you must stand: standM at the flap itself, to pitch the tent and to crawl in (you walk there first, so you never stand where the tent goes up); slotM to pitch or lay (the card walks you there); ringM for Light and Feed on the here-bar; flapM: Rest is offered anywhere on the camp ground after dark, or within flapM of the flap (pressing it walks you to the flap first).
fireNote: One handful of fuel burns flameH game hours; feeding adds flameH more, up to maxFuelH held at once. With more than highH left it burns high; below that the flames sink toward lowFlame of their height, then embers (F9). A handful fed takes catchS seconds to catch, the flame holding its size, then surges by flare (a share of a high fire) and settles over flareS seconds (Matt's fire study, October 29, 2026); only the look waits, the fuel hours change the moment it is fed. Feed takes the handful from the pack, else from the camp's stick pile; Light on a cold ring does too. After the first evening, Light works whenever the ring holds fuel. embers (lit or banked by a rest) last emberH, then the ring is cold; the cold ring's ash fades over ashFadeH (docs/future/13 3.5, CP-11). All worked out from the clock (src/world/camp/fire.js), so live play and catch-up agree. The light: a lightK blackbody of cd candela at heightM over the ring, reaching nothing at rangeM (a smooth window, so from above at night the camp is a small warm pool, C-38), flickering by flicker at about flickerHz; banked embers glow emberCd at emberLightK. Rain over rainLow drops a lit fire to a hissing low flame (rainFlame of its size) without putting it out. How burnt the wood looks in each state is the star's (star.endChar, S4). fuelK (P2i): a fuel kind's flame hours as a share of flameH; charcoal burns slow and hot, twice as long as sticks, and the ring's card says so. night (P2i fire-nights): dusk at duskH and dawn at dawnH (hours of the day); a night with needH hours of fire between them, lit or embers, is a fire-night, and the ring gives charcoal and ash from that dawn until the next dusk (recipes/world/gather.json kinds charcoal, ash). The fire remembers its last keep fire-nights.
starNote: The star fire (S4; src/world/camp/star.js; Matt: always a star of wood): logs copies of Matt's single log (props.models.log, logLenM long as made, drawn sizeM long), radiating from startDeg (degrees in the ring model's frame, 0 along its +x) with jitterDeg and sizeJitter seeded, their inner ends innerM from the middle, resting on the stones they cross: each tipped up just enough to clear every stone under it (the tops of the ring's stones and the hearth stones are baked into src/world/camp/ring-top.js by tools/bake-ring-top.mjs), at least minTiltDeg; where that would be steeper than maxTiltDeg it is shortened instead (down to minStretch of its length), so its outer end stops against the stone. Ash under ashTopM high may be sunk into by sinkM; stone is kept clearM off. logHalfW, logThick: the log model's half width and height. With the hearth stones in the middle the logs lined up with a stone (within stoneHalfDeg) stop at stoneClearM, the rest reach in to hearthInnerM under the pot. As the fire burns its logs are pushed in pushM for each handful's flame hours, up to maxBurntM burnt away (banked or cold, settledBurnt of that); a new lighting lays fresh logs. endChar: how far along from the inner end each log is burnt, by the fire's state; glow: its embers (lit, and all of it in rain). The flame and smoke stay centred on the star. workM: where pieces laid at the fire to fire overnight sit, between the logs (m from the middle).

hearth.slipNote: A pot fired with ochre slip (the pan finds): its fired clay times this (linear), the warm red of iron-stained earth.

hearthNote: The hearth (S4, S5; src/world/camp/hearth.js): the hearth stones (props.models hearth-stones, made at the workbench) stand in the ring's middle, their tops stonesTopM up; one pot stands on them at a time, the others wait in their own slots at the ring's side (slots: the camp slot each fired piece goes to; the land recipe places them), and a click on a waiting pot swaps it on. pots: the pots that can stand on the hearth (the dye pot's slot is drawn, a flat stand stone, standScale times the stone and standSquash high; its make waits for Phase 4). benchAt: where shaped pieces wait pale on the workbench's slab (m, in the bench's own frame: x across, y up, z toward where you work). carryAt: the pot held in both arms, from between your hands (m: right, down, forward). lift: the pot on the hearth (potM wide, potH tall) and the pieces by the fire, firing or pale on the workbench (pieceM, pieceH), as upright cylinders the pointer finds before the ring under them (m). hintS: how long a hint shows (s; the rill hint and the first shaped piece's).
lanternNote: The hand lantern (docs/06: 2,200 K, 8 cd; its reach kept to rangeM so the camp's light stays a small pool from above). hangM: where the lantern's base hangs, in the tent model's frame (m, +z the flap), just in front of the front poles; handleM: the lantern's height to its handle. hookM: the front poles' crossing (read from the tent model), where a loop of cord (hookLoopM round, cordM thick, cordSrgb) holds it, the cord running down to the handle (F2: it reads as hung from every side). carryDropM: how far below the hand's wrist it swings when carried. glassNits, glassM: its lit glass, a small emissive glow that feeds bloom. lightsAtSunDeg: lit once the sun is lower than this (degrees).
flameNote: The fire's flame is the live fire sim (fireSim), painted in bands; its flame cards are retired (October 29, 2026). nits: the soft glow the sim's heat adds to the HDR (times fireSim.glowShare), so bloom and exposure answer to the fire. heightM: about how tall a high flame stands (where the embers' smoke starts and the halo sits). glowNits, glowM: a soft halo card round it, never smaller than minPx on screen, so the camp reads as a small warm point from above (C-38).
fireSimNote: The volumetric fire (Matt's fire study, October 29, 2026; tools/fire-lab.html; src/render/passes/camp-fire-sim.js, src/shaders/camp-fire-sim.wgsl): a small smoke and heat fluid on a grid of cells over a box boxM (m) standing on the ring, stepped every stepS seconds (at most maxStepsPerFrame a frame; warmSteps at once when the camp comes into view lit), with pressurePasses Jacobi passes (lowGrid and lowPressurePasses on the low tier). Hot gas rises by buoyancy, smoke weighs smokeWeight; heat cools at cooling a second, smoke fades at smokeFade; curl noise stirs it by turbulence; damping a second. spots hot spots add emitHeat heat and emitSmoke smoke, driven by level = levelScale x shown flame + fire.flare x the surge; at the star logs' burnt ends, each by its glow. It runs while the fire is lit and afterS seconds after, only while the fire's box is in view; glowShare: the share of flame.nits its soft glow adds to the HDR. Drawn by marching samples steps a ray (lowSamples on low), heat broken up by rising noise at detail cycles a meter, smoke at smokeDensity. bands: the painted flame from the collected heat: its edge, the band steps at, softness from soft[0] (soft) to soft[1] (banded), stylize of the way (Matt's 0.75), colors display sRGB rose, orange, amber, cream; halo: the soft orange outside the edge. feed: with fire.catchS, flare and flareS, the catch-then-surge feed (Matt, October 29, 2026): the smoke puff of a caught handful decays over puffS, and the shown flame eases toward the game's at rise and fall (times ease) a second. tiers: grid, pressure passes, samples and the volume's resolution share per quality tier; every tier uses the low settings at half resolution (Matt, October 29, 2026: the grain is a nice texture, and it is cheaper), the spec's fuller settings (grid, pressurePasses, samples) kept for comparison in the lab. Visual only, never saved, never in catch-up.
smokeNote: C-29: count soft puffs (lowCount on the low tier), each living lifeS seconds, rising riseMps and leaning with the weather's wind by lean (meters a second at full wind), growing from sizeM[0] to sizeM[1], at most opacity. albedo: lit by the sky, sun and fire, never painted. embersShare: how much smoke banked embers give; rainThick: thicker in rain; mistLow: in mist it rises this much slower and hangs low. nearFadeM: puffs fade near the eye, so overdraw stays small. Midges keep midgeClearM from it.
steamNote: P2e: steam off a pot on the hearth, drawn as the smoke is (the same puffs, its own numbers): soft white wisps topM above the stones, simmer strong while a pot holds water over a lit fire, steep while the tea pot steeps after Brew. Live only.
mothsNote: C-30: a few moths circle the fire and the lantern after dark (the sun lower than atSunDeg), on loose seeded orbits, wings flapping at flapHz. Lit by the fire, so they read pale against the dark. Live only, never saved. The lantern's moths circle a point that follows the lantern on a critically damped spring (followS seconds behind), so the arm's swing never jerks them: while you walk it leans toward your shoulder (shoulderM over the ground), by lean at leanAtMps and less below, and it settles on the lantern when you stand. Farther than snapM from where it should be (the lantern back on its pole), it jumps there.
steelNote: The fire steel and its flint (the walker carries both; src/world/camp/steel-mesh.js): in the hands only while striking. Each of strikesAt (shares of the strike act) sends sparks sparks for sparkS seconds; the twigs catch as the act ends. steelSrgb, flintSrgb: their colours (sRGB), with their roughness.
canvasNote: Canvas weathering (C-35, B1 C2; src/world/camp/canvas.js, prop-draw.wgsl): from the game hours since firstPitchedHour, eased out to a cap. The canvas pales and greys over fadeSeasons (at fadeCap: its brightness times pale plus paleAdd, greyShare of its colour gone to grey tinted greyTint), all in linear albedo (the palette paints at tonemap). The tent is one painted model, so the paint is sorted by hue: below woodHue[0] degrees (sRGB hue, blended to woodHue[1]) it is wood (the poles and the stitched seams), which silvers over poles.silverSeasons toward a pale grey, silverBase plus silverGain of its own brightness (the grain kept), tinted silverTint. The poles' paint is the canvas's own olive, so they are found by where they stand in the tent's frame instead: past endZ (|z| along the ridge, blended) and within reachM of the slopes' end edges (the slope runs from frameM[1] out at the ground to the ridge frameM[0] high), or at the crossed tops; warm paint inside the tent (insideM: half width at the ground, narrowing to the ridge, and height) is the bedroll and groundsheet and is left as it is; paler than liningLum (sRGB lightness) is the inner lining, which fades liningShare as much; the rest is canvas. Patches: the first sewn on at patchAtSeasons, one more each patchEverySeasons, up to patchMax, placed from the tent slot's seed on the tent's two slopes (centres within patchZ along the ridge and patchY up from the ground, half sizes from patchHalfM, turned up to patchTurn radians): a newer cloth, the fresh canvas times one of patchTints, fading only patchFade as much, with a dashed stitch of stitchAlbedo stitchM wide, dashes stitchDashM long, round its edge. checkGapM: the canvas check's spacing (?camp=canvas: tents at other ages in a row behind yours along its ridge). dye: the hook for Phase 4's dyed canvas (section 9.3): a dye slides toward weathered (linear) by min(fadeCap, 1 - exp(-seasons since dyed / fadeTau)); not used yet.
propsNote: Matt's models (meters, Y up, origin at the base centre, front +Z), drawn with their own maps by src/render/passes/props.js. look: albedo and roughness scale, normal map strength and its green's sign. shade: the soft contact shadow's half sizes (m, along the model's own x and z) and darkness. The tent model carries its rolled bedroll inside. ember: the embers' glow colour, emberNits at full glow, breathing at emberHz; charAlbedo: burnt wood; dryTint, dryMix: a drying herb's green fades toward straw, its brightness kept times dryTint, dryMix of the way at fully dry (prop-draw.wgsl). The apothecary bench, drying rack, mortar and pestle are Matt's (S2), and so is the clay furnace (the spring-ore plan; it faces the workbench, its tapping arch toward where you stand); the rack's baked bunches are lifted off it and drawn as the four rack-bunch variants, one per bunch hung (tools/assets/drop-paint.mjs). The hamper (P2j) is drawn with the stores (pack.json store.look).
restNote: C-39: Rest, after sunset and until wakeBeforeSunriseMin minutes before sunrise, runs the night as catch-up behind the cream screen and wakes you kneeling at the flap just before sunrise. viewSideRad, viewDistanceM, viewPitchDeg: after pitching and on waking, the low view from this far round from behind you (radians), this far off and this far down, so you, the tent and the ring are all in it and the tent never fills it.
stationsNote: The camp's stations (docs/future/13 3.12; S1; src/world/camp/stations.js, src/ui/station.js). spots: the part spots on each station's surface; action: its one action's icon. standM: you stand this far out from a bench's working edge (the side away from the slot it faces); reachM: in reach of it from there; awayM: walk this much further off and the workspace closes, every laid part back in its pouch. ui: the workspace card sits its surface and the pouches side by side from sideBySidePx wide, stacked below that; its part spots and buttons are targetPx (never under 48), and it is at most maxWidthPx wide.
rackNote: The drying rack (S2; src/world/camp/keeps.js): a herb bunch dries over dryDays game days from the hour it was hung, worked out from the clock, so live play and catch-up agree. yawDeg: its turn from the slot's seaward yaw (the slot lies alongU). hangs: where Matt's own bunches hung on his model (m, the rack's frame; tools/assets/models.json drying-rack-bunches, from the report), filled from the top row left to right, as many as pack.json piles.rackBunches; each bunch wears one of variants seeded bunch models, turned up to bunchYawDeg either way.
apothecaryNote: Where the mortar and pestle sit on the apothecary bench's worktop (m, in the bench's own frame: x across it, y up, z toward where you work; then a turn in degrees). The worktop is 0.63 m up (read from the model).
standingNote: CP-13: in catch-up only, once a game day of the absence, each creature already Tolerant or closer whose home lies within reachM of the pad gains trust (a feeding is 0.06).
giftStoneNote: B1 C1 (docs/future/13 C-14, C-37): the gift stone made at the workbench (cook.json makes gift-stone) and drawn in code in the camp's gift slot. stoneRadiiM: the low flat stone's half sizes (x, y, z; m), lump (how uneven its outline is), sink (share of its height below the ground), stoneColor and the pale flecks of lichenColor (linear), yawDeg its turn from seaward. shells: how many shells sit along its far side, each shellM across (m) at shellRingShare of its radius, coloured from shellColors. A gift laid on it lies at giftRingShare of its radius on the near side, each giftApartRad round from the last, drawn giftScale times its real size (findable scale), and you stand standM off its edge (on the ring's side) and reach it within reachM. pass: the draw pass's contact shadow. tokens: how each kind of gift is drawn on the stone, by its gift id: a 'bundle' of count strands lenM long and radiusM thick tied with tieColor, a 'feather', or a small wrapped 'parcel' (any kind not listed).
keepsakeShelfNote: B2 (Matt, October 30, 2026): the keepsake shelf, made at the workbench (cook.json makes keepsake-shelf) into the camp's shelf slot, drawn with its model (props.models keepsake-shelf; meters, origin at the middle of its base, front +z, turned to face the pad's middle) and holding the Shelf tab's keepsakes in order (src/world/camp/keepsake-shelf.js, shelf-fit.js). slotsM: the sixteen spots in the model's frame, top left to bottom right as you face it, each on its plank's top (the source model's empties slot_01 to slot_16, which the web copy drops; scaled with it); letterTinM, tinHalfM: the letter tin on top, its middle and half sizes; boxM: the shelf's box for a click's ray (low down a click on it would pass to the ground behind); look: the source's look_from empty, the camera's place in front and its pitch down (the view eases there when the shelf is clicked from above), stepped back along that line to minDistanceM so the whole shelf is in view. fit: how a keepsake sits in its spot: at scale (the findable scale) but at least minM along its longest side and never wider, taller or deeper than the spot holds (maxWideM, maxHighM: under the plank above, maxDeepM), its longer side along the plank and turned up to jitterDeg either way by its seed; families: stand (a bottle on its base) or leanDeg (a flat thing leant back against the boards, set leanBackM further back). sitM: a hair above the plank. pass: the keepsakes' draw pass. standM: where you stand in front of it (beyond its half depth); reachM: how near the walk takes you; liftM: the lift's reach from there (the shelf and its keepsakes, no further); cardPadM: the card's footprint grown by this; tinCardM: a click this near the tin's spot opens its card. testStandM, testViewRad: the test link ?camp=shelf stands you beside it (in its frame) with the low view turned this far from straight in front.
knownNote: A known place (C-36): within reachM of the pad's center, every creature's comfort ring is multiplied by 1 - (1 - ringAtFull) * known. known grows by perSeason for each season in which you rested at camp at least restsPerSeason times (Matt's brief, B1: 6; the spec's first draft said 2), up to 1, and never falls.
bedNote: The herb bed off the pad (C-24; the land's camp.offPad.bed): looked at every checkS seconds; once a plant stands in it, edging pebbles are drawn round it for good, spacingM apart along each side, outM outside the strip and up to jitterM off the line, sized sizeM (a scale on a 0.5 m pebble shape, so 0.1 is 5 cm across the long way), coloured color in shades.
